zh.title: 更准确的雷达状态与版本日志
zh.summary: 本次更新修正雷达图层的加载状态，并优化版本日志展示与插件链接复制。

items.text: 修复雷达画面已经显示后，页面仍持续提示正在加载的问题。
移除关于页的版本详情按钮，精简版本日志操作区。
版本日志按最新版本系列汇总展示，例如 0.9.1 会同时展示已有的 0.9.x 日志。
新增复制最新版本插件链接按钮，并去除日志顶部重复展示的版本号和日期。

en.title: More accurate radar status and release notes
en.summary: This update corrects radar loading feedback and improves release-note presentation and plugin-link copying.

items.text: Fixed the radar overlay remaining in a loading state after the radar image was already visible.
Removed the version-details button from the About page to simplify the release-note actions.
Grouped release notes by the latest version series, so 0.9.1 also shows the available 0.9.x history.
Added a button to copy the latest plugin URL and removed the duplicated version and date from the log header.
